basic_details.scholarship_name: Cornell University Graduate School Fellowships & Doctoral Assistantships
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Cornell University (Ithaca & Cornell Tech, New York, USA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Computer Science (Bowers CIS), Electrical and Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, Mathematics, and Operations Research and Information Engineering (ORIE).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted research doctoral students receive full multi-year fellowship guarantees (~450 to 550 doctoral awards annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally on merit; Pakistani scholars in computing, engineering, and physics regularly win full Cornell doctoral funding (~4 to 8 awards annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full 5 years of doctoral study guaranteed
basic_details.monthly_stipend_amount: $43,500 to $48,000 / year (approx. $3,625 to $4,000 / month; ~PKR 1,000,000 to 1,110,000 / month) 12-month living stipend plus 100% full tuition waiver and comprehensive Student Health Plan

nationality_requirements: Open to international students worldwide including Pakistan as well as U.S. citizens/PR
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; selection based strictly on academic excellence and research potential.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 16-year Bachelor's or 18-year Master's degree with exceptional academic standing (equivalent to minimum GPA 3.80+ / 4.00 or top-decile rank) from an HEC-recognized university.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum undergraduate/graduate GPA of 3.8 / 4.0; admitted Cornell doctoral candidates are evaluated on research impact.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Computer science, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, physics, mathematics, or related quantitative field.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or final-year undergraduate/master's students completing degree before September.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior scientific research publications, conference presentations, or industrial software contributions strongly advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT minimum 100 or IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 mandatory for Cornell Graduate School.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must be admitted to a Cornell University PhD program.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Coordinated with Cornell standard multi-year doctoral funding guarantee.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full Cornell doctoral tuition and mandatory student activity fees paid for all 5 years of study.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~$29,500 / year endowed / ~$42,000 value; ~PKR 8,200,000 to 11,700,000 / year)

admission_application_fee.details: Cornell graduate application fee of $105; fee waivers available upon demonstration of financial need.

accommodation.details: Cornell graduate housing (Hasbrouck Apartments, Thurston Court) or private rental apartments in Ithaca funded comfortably via monthly stipend.
accommodation.amount: Funded from stipend (~$800 to $1,300 / month rent in Ithaca)

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month living stipend of $43,500 to $48,000 / year ($3,625 to $4,000 / month; ~PKR 1,000,000 to 1,110,000 / month) disbursed semimonthly.

airfare.details: Relocation flights to New York/Ithaca are self-funded or subsidized by departmental relocation allowances.

visa_fee.details: U.S. F-1 Student Visa application fee (~$185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (~$350) paid to U.S. government.

health_insurance.details: Cornell University Student Health Plan (SHP) 100% covered for all doctoral fellows, providing comprehensive in-network medical and mental health care.

food_allowance.details: Dining and groceries covered through monthly living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Cornell University Library system (Olin, Uris, Carpenter Hall), high-performance computing clusters (Cornell Center for Advanced Computing), and laboratory infrastructure included.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Graduate School Conference Travel Grants provide up to $1,500 to $2,500 per year for presenting research papers at conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: TCAT bus pass is completely free for all first-year graduate students and subsidized thereafter, providing unlimited transit throughout Ithaca and Tompkins County.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single world-leading Ivy League research institution (Cornell University).
participating_institutions: Cornell University (Ithaca & Cornell Tech, New York, USA)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World University Rankings #16, U.S. News Top 15 National Universities; world-renowned for Ann S. Bowers College of Computing and Information Science, Engineering, and Cornell Tech.
available_majors: PhD in Computer Science (AI, Systems, Theory, Robotics, Graphics)
PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering
PhD in Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering
PhD in Operations Research and Information Engineering (ORIE)
PhD in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering
PhD in Physics and Applied Physics
PhD in Materials Science and Engineering
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 5 years of full-time doctoral study and research
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's degree with 3.8+ GPA, verified transcripts, TOEFL 100+ or IELTS 7.0+, three academic letters of recommendation, CV detailing research outputs, and statement of purpose.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Cornell Computer Science (Bowers CIS) and ORIE are intensely competitive (acceptance rate ~5%); demonstrating prior peer-reviewed research publications or strong technical contributions is crucial.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Articulate clear research synergy with specific Cornell faculty research groups and centers (e.g., Cornell Robotics, Center for Applied Math, Cornell Quantum Initiative).

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Cornell Graduate School Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Cornell Graduate School application portal, choose target PhD department, select faculty of interest, upload transcripts, statement of purpose, CV, test scores, and register 3 referees.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore Cornell faculty profiles and published papers in your field of interest.
Step 2: Obtain valid TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.0+) score report.
Step 3: Submit PhD application on Cornell Graduate School portal by December 15 deadline.
Step 4: Upload official academic transcripts, statement of purpose, and curriculum vitae.
Step 5: Three academic referees submit letters directly into the Cornell system.
Step 6: Departmental faculty admissions committee reviews applications and selects doctoral candidates.
Step 7: Successful applicants receive formal admission offer with full 5-year guaranteed funding package in February/March.
Step 8: Accept offer by April 15, receive I-20, and apply for U.S. F-1 Student Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Universal Doctoral Funding: 100% of admitted Cornell PhD students receive full multi-year funding guarantees without separate financial aid application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via automated secure electronic appraisal forms.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (approx. 1,000 words) describing academic trajectory, research questions, proposed methodologies, and alignment with Cornell faculty.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Incorporated into statement of purpose; writing sample / research paper required by many departments.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic research CV detailing education, publications, conference presentations, awards, and technical proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews via Zoom with prospective faculty advisors evaluating research depth and theoretical foundation.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT 100+ or IELTS 7.0+ mandatory; GRE optional/department-specific.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: $105 (approx. PKR 29,000; fee waiver available upon request)
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Official HEC verified transcripts required upon final matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translation of all non-English transcripts.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online submission via Cornell Graduate School portal.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: December 15 (Computer Science, ECE, ORIE) / January 5 (Other engineering programs)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual admission cycle for Fall entry; applications strictly due by mid-December.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (Academic GPA, transcript rigor, foundational coursework grades)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 50% (Demonstrated research originality, peer-reviewed publications, technical problem solving)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry R&D lab experience or software engineering)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Faculty Admissions Committees and Cornell Graduate School.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic review prioritizing research depth, originality, peer-reviewed outputs, and scientific match with Cornell research laboratories.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~3,500 to 5,000 doctoral applicants across engineering and applied sciences
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100% of admitted PhD students receive full multi-year funding guarantees
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2.5% to 4.5% for extraordinary applicants with peer-reviewed publications and near-perfect GPAs
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: Undergraduate GPA >= 3.85 / 4.00, typically with 1 to 3 peer-reviewed publications in reputable international venues
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Scholars holding bachelor's or research master's degrees with exceptional quantitative skills, peer-reviewed publications, and compelling research visions.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from premier Pakistani universities (NUST, LUMS, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, PIEAS, UET) and international graduate programs.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: USA, China, India, Canada, Pakistan, South Korea, Germany, Singapore, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply through official Cornell website at gradschool.cornell.edu.
Cornell never works with commercial recruiting agencies.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of $105 is paid directly through the secure portal; fee waivers are available for eligible applicants.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Commercial agencies cannot influence Cornell admissions; fraudulent applications result in permanent bans.
hidden_costs_breakdown: IELTS or TOEFL test fees: ~PKR 55,000 to 65,000.
Relocation flight to New York/Ithaca: ~PKR 250,000 to 350,000.
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: Cornell doctoral students must pay tuition. Reality: 100% of admitted Cornell doctoral students receive full tuition coverage, health insurance, and a generous 12-month living stipend ($43.5k-$48k/yr).
Myth: You need a master's degree to apply. Reality: Students holding a 4-year Bachelor's degree are directly eligible to apply to Cornell PhD programs.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend values; current verified Cornell 12-month doctoral stipend is $43,500 to $48,000.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic progress and minimum B+ (3.3/4.0) average in graduate coursework.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time resident study in Ithaca or Cornell Tech (NYC) and active contribution to research laboratory projects.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews and doctoral admission to candidacy examination (A exam) administered by the special committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistant or Graduate Research Assistant duties are integrated into doctoral training; outside employment is restricted.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates are eligible for 3-year U.S. STEM OPT work authorization.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Obligation to fulfill designated departmental research or teaching duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated if student withdraws or fails academic milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from graduate program special committee and faculty supervisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Full guaranteed funding for 5 years; dissertation completion support available for year 6.
